description: This file defines a PHP trait named DecoratorTrait within the OrangeHRM project, providing methods for lazy initialization of a decorator object and obtaining its class name based on the containing class.

methods.name: getDecorator
methods.description: Returns the decorator object, creating it if it does not currently exist.

methods.name: getDecoratorClassName
methods.description: Constructs and returns the class name of the decorator based on the current class name.
